name: Chicken with Lemon Dill-Artichoke Sauce, Roasted Potatoes & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.23 kg new potatoes
2 crowns broccoli
½ lemon
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove from the oven. Add broccoli, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, zest and juice lemon into the reserved skillet.

Add broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet with the lemon; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
118 ml (½ cup) heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, drain and roughly chop artichokes. Place in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (170 ml) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the artichokes.
When the sauce has thickened, add artichokes and dill, then stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Spoon sauce over chicken and enjoy!
